notes.title: random patch 3
notes.notes:
hiiiiii so i did some stuff
- fixed a crash when changing keybinds on the ARENA map screen
- polished up the lasers, made em look pretty, clarified the "gem" position, less flashing
- summoned animals can now be hit with balls! as it always should have been tbh

anyway enjoy hope youre having a good week
thanks for playing <3
[i]-chloe[/i]

notes.title: first patch wow!!!
notes.notes:

check your %APPDATA% 10S[i] [/i]FOREVER folder
if theres a save.game file in there, copy it to the playdata subfolder
this is probably fixed but somebody had an issue so letting you know[/p][p][/p][p]thanks for playing <3[/p][p][i]-chloe[/i][/p]
